settings.legal.confirm.delete: Delete draft {version}? A deleted draft cannot be recovered.
settings.legal.confirm.publish: Publish {version}? A published text can no longer be edited or deleted; to change it, create a new version.
settings.legal.confirm.publishReplaces: The version in force, {current}, is retired at the same time.
settings.legal.confirm.retire: Retire {version}? A retired version cannot be put back in force, and the {kind} ({language}) has no version in force until you publish a new one.
settings.legal.editor.bodyHint: Use ## for headings, - for lists and **bold** for what needs emphasis.
settings.legal.editor.skeletonHint: The skeleton holds headings only, with no legal wording: purpose, data collected, retention, rights and how to use them, contact, processors and hosting abroad. You write the text.
settings.legal.editor.skeletonUnavailabl: The skeleton can be used only while the text box is empty.
settings.legal.editor.title: Title
settings.legal.editor.versionFormat: A version label starts with a lower-case letter or a digit and holds only lower-case letters without accents, digits, dots and hyphens, at most 40 characters.
settings.legal.editor.versionHint: Suggested: {suggestion}. Every consent a customer or staff member gives records this label.
settings.legal.editor.versionTaken: This text already has a version with this label; use another one.
settings.legal.frozen: Not saved: a published or retired text cannot be edited or deleted; create a new version.
settings.legal.intro: Each kind of text has versions. A published version can no longer be edited or deleted, so that every consent a customer or staff member gives points at the exact text they read. The business writes the content; the app offers only a skeleton of headings.
settings.legal.readOnly: Only an owner who sees every store can write, publish or retire legal texts; you are viewing them read-only.
settings.legal.slot.consent.body: The list of customer consents and personal-data requests comes in phase {phase} of the roadmap; every consent records the version label of the text in force.
settings.legal.slot.consent.title: Customer consent and personal-data requests
settings.legal.slot.legalForm.body: The business's legal form is chosen on the Stores page.
settings.legal.slot.legalForm.title: Legal form
settings.legal.stale: Not done: this text was already published or withdrawn elsewhere; the list has been reloaded.
